findings.rationale: The checker accepts an irreversible effect once an idempotency_key is present, but lowering only validates the path and neither the kernel state nor scaffold metadata retains the key. Consequently the generated contract cannot record consumed keys or prevent two invocations sharing a key from repeating an irreversible effect.

A request is blocked only while Pending or after Succeeded. Once Failed or TimedOut, the original command may start the same correlation again and reset attempts to 1, regardless of whether the retry action already exhausted max_attempts, permitting unbounded attempt cycles.

The structural check treats a nonempty compensation_events declaration as satisfying the irreversible-effect requirement, yet outcome classification never checks compensation_events and no transition assigns the generated Compensated member. A compensation event is therefore omitted or classified by an unrelated name heuristic, commonly as Succeeded.

Both lowerers validate or encode after_event in the action name but guard compensation solely on trigger_event. Compensation can run without the required prior after event, so the declared ordering contract is not enforced.

Each observation action sets its event flag true while resetting every other event flag false. An awaits_mode of all therefore cannot remember events observed in separate transitions; it succeeds only when all flags happen to be emitted in one action, contrary to saga-history semantics.

Only the first step is tied to starts_on, and awaits are ignored whenever a step also emits. No phase/completion state links later steps to predecessors or consumes a step, so emitting steps and their timeout variants can execute out of order and repeatedly; timeout has the same guards as normal execution and may fire immediately.

correlation accepts any Event.field and returns only the leaf field name, while request dispatch is grouped independently by handles/request_event. Starting the effect then indexes lifecycle state with any same-named command/state symbol, allowing an unrelated event declaration to determine the key type and an unrelated in-scope value to determine the key.

Logical typing and expression resolution explicitly support Seq, but surface_type omits the Seq constructor. Any Seq field that passes expression validation later fails while generating state or value-object types.

The AST lowerer diagnoses an empty enum, but the separately exported textual domain_kernel_source indexes members[0] while choosing a default and performs no equivalent enum validation. A state field of an empty enum can therefore panic the process instead of returning CoreError.
